name: browser.vault.fill
description: Fill a saved website login into one managed-browser tab (targetId from the browser pages list or a navigate result). The host types the credential only when the tab's live origin EXACTLY matches one of the login's origins (no subdomain or scheme matching) and refuses on a mismatch, a navigation, a reverted value or a missing field, writing nothing it reports. fields defaults to identifier and password; request totp on the 2FA step for the current code. You never see the password, setup key or code, and the form is never submitted: check the page and submit it yourself.
